add-text-box-field-to-pdf-acroform.title: Create PDF with AcroForm Text Field
add-text-box-field-to-pdf-acroform.description: Demonstrates how to create a new PDF document, add an AcroForm, and place a single‑line text box field on the first page using Aspose.Pdf.

create-pdf-with-top-checkbox.title: Add Top-Positioned Checkbox to PDF AcroForm
create-pdf-with-top-checkbox.description: Creates a new PDF, adds a blank page, and inserts an AcroForm checkbox field positioned near the top of the page.

add-gender-radio-button-group-to-pdf.title: Create PDF with Gender Radio Button Group
add-gender-radio-button-group-to-pdf.description: Shows how to generate a new PDF, add an AcroForm radio button field for gender selection, set a default option, and save the document.

add-listbox-to-pdf-form.title: Create PDF with AcroForm List Box
add-listbox-to-pdf-form.description: Shows how to generate a new PDF, add an AcroForm list box containing country options, and save the document using Aspose.Pdf.

create-acroform-textbox-appearance.title: Create PDF with AcroForm TextBox and Set Appearance
create-acroform-textbox-appearance.description: Demonstrates how to create a new PDF, add a TextBox field to its AcroForm, and customize the field's font, size, and colors using Aspose.Pdf.

fill-pdf-text-field.title: Fill Text Field in PDF using Aspose.Pdf
fill-pdf-text-field.description: Demonstrates loading an existing PDF, locating a specific text box form field, setting its value, and saving the updated document.

set-checkbox-field-in-pdf.title: Set PDF Checkbox Field
set-checkbox-field-in-pdf.description: Loads an existing PDF, locates a checkbox form field, sets its checked state based on a boolean value, and saves the updated document.

select-radio-button-option-in-pdf-form.title: Select Radio Button Option in PDF Form
select-radio-button-option-in-pdf-form.description: Loads an existing PDF, locates a radio button field by name, selects a specified option, and saves the updated document.

select-listbox-option-in-pdf-form.title: Select ListBox Entry in PDF Form by Index
select-listbox-option-in-pdf-form.description: Shows how to load a PDF, locate a ListBox form field, select an item using its zero‑based index, and save the modified document.

populate-pdf-form-fields-from-dictionary.title: Populate PDF Form Fields from a Dictionary
populate-pdf-form-fields-from-dictionary.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, iterating over its form fields, and assigning values from a case‑insensitive dictionary, then saving the updated document.

read-pdf-form-field-value.title: Read PDF Form Field Value
read-pdf-form-field-value.description: Loads a PDF document, retrieves a named form field by its name, and writes the field's value to the console.

export-pdf-form-fields-to-json.title: Extract PDF Form Fields to JSON
export-pdf-form-fields-to-json.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through all form fields, reads each field's value (handling text boxes, checkboxes, radio groups, list boxes, and combo boxes), and serializes the collected data into a formatted JSON string.

import-xfdf-form-data-into-pdf.title: Import XML Data into PDF Form Fields
import-xfdf-form-data-into-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading an XML file and populating matching fields in a PDF form using Aspose.Pdf.

add-blank-page-to-pdf-form.title: Add Blank Page to PDF Form
add-blank-page-to-pdf-form.description: Shows how to load an existing PDF form, append a new blank page, and save the document while preserving all existing form fields.

add-new-page-with-acroform-fields.title: Add New Page with AcroForm Fields to PDF
add-new-page-with-acroform-fields.description: Demonstrates how to append a fresh page to an existing PDF and place various AcroForm fields (text box, checkbox, radio button group) on that page using Aspose.Pdf.

delete-form-field-from-pdf.title: Delete Specific Form Field from PDF
delete-form-field-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, locating a form field by its name, deleting the field, and saving the updated document.

flatten-pdf-remove-form-fields.title: Remove All Form Fields from PDF
flatten-pdf-remove-form-fields.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, enumerating all interactive form fields, deleting them, and saving the result as a plain, non‑interactive PDF.

set-form-field-border-color-width.title: Style PDF Form Field Border and Color
set-form-field-border-color-width.description: Shows how to load a PDF, locate a form field, and apply a corporate border style, width, and color before saving the document.

highlight-required-form-fields.title: Highlight Required Form Field Background Color
highlight-required-form-fields.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, locating a specific text box form field, setting its background color to highlight required input, and saving the updated document.

set-font-size-style-pdf-textbox-field.title: Set Font Size and Style for PDF TextBox Field
set-font-size-style-pdf-textbox-field.description: The example loads a PDF, finds a specific text box form field, and updates its default appearance to use a larger, readable font (Arial, 14 pt) with black color, then saves the modified document.

set-pdf-form-field-read-only.title: Set PDF Form Field to Read‑Only
set-pdf-form-field-read-only.description: Loads a PDF, populates a text box form field, marks it as read‑only to prevent further editing, and saves the updated document.

mark-pdf-form-field-as-required.title: Mark PDF Form Field as Required
mark-pdf-form-field-as-required.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, locate a text box form field, set its Required property to true so validation fails when empty, and save the updated document.

add-tooltip-to-pdf-form-textbox.title: Add Tooltip to PDF Form Field
add-tooltip-to-pdf-form-textbox.description: Creates a PDF document, adds a text box form field, and sets its AlternateName property to display a tooltip that guides the user on the expected input format.

set-default-value-for-pdf-form-textbox.title: Set Default Value for PDF TextBox Form Field
set-default-value-for-pdf-form-textbox.description: Shows how to load a PDF, locate a TextBox form field, assign a default value that appears when the PDF is opened, and save the modified document.

add-blank-page-save-as-new-pdf.title: Add Text Annotation to PDF and Save As New File
add-blank-page-save-as-new-pdf.description: Shows how to open a PDF, place a text annotation on the first page, and save the modified document to a new file to keep the original unchanged.

save-pdf-incremental-updates.title: Save PDF with Incremental Update for Form Data
save-pdf-incremental-updates.description: Demonstrates copying a PDF, opening it with read/write access, updating a form field, and saving using Aspose.Pdf's automatic incremental update to retain previous revisions.

batch-fill-pdf-form-fields.title: Batch Fill PDF Form Fields with Same Values
batch-fill-pdf-form-fields.description: Shows how to iterate over a folder of PDF files, load each document with Aspose.Pdf, assign predefined values to matching form fields, and save the updated PDFs.

batch-fill-pdf-forms-from-xml.title: Batch Fill PDF Forms from XML Files
batch-fill-pdf-forms-from-xml.description: Demonstrates how to iterate over a folder of PDFs, locate matching XML files, and populate the PDF form fields with the XML data, saving the filled PDFs to an output directory.

batch-export-pdf-form-data-to-xml.title: Batch Export PDF Form Data to XML
batch-export-pdf-form-data-to-xml.description: Shows how to loop through a directory of PDF files, read AcroForm fields with Aspose.Pdf, and write each document's form data to an individual XML file.

convert-pdf-form-json-to-csv.title: Convert Form Data JSON to CSV
convert-pdf-form-json-to-csv.description: Shows how to read a JSON file with extracted form data, parse it into objects, and write the data as a CSV file suitable for spreadsheet import.

validate-required-pdf-form-fields.title: Validate Required PDF Form Fields Before Saving
validate-required-pdf-form-fields.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate over its form fields, check the Required flag, verify that required fields are filled, and only save the document when validation passes.

acroform-with-margins.title: Create PDF with AcroForm Fields Using Relative Positioning
acroform-with-margins.description: Demonstrates how to add AcroForm fields (a text box and a checkbox) to a PDF using page margins and relative percentages for positioning.

create-pdf-with-xfa-form.title: Create PDF with XFA Text Box Field
create-pdf-with-xfa-form.description: Shows how to generate a PDF, add a text box form field that will be part of an XFA form when XFA support is enabled, and save the document.

extract-xfa-form-data-to-xml.title: Extract XFA Form Data from PDF to XML
extract-xfa-form-data-to-xml.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, detect XFA form data, retrieve the XFA datasets as XML, and save the XML to a file.

import-xfa-data-from-xml.title: Import XFA Data from XML into PDF
import-xfa-data-from-xml.description: Shows how to load a PDF containing an XFA form, bind XML data to the form using BindXml, and save the resulting filled PDF.

merge-pdfs-unique-acroform-field-names.title: Merge PDFs while Preserving Unique AcroForm Field Names
merge-pdfs-unique-acroform-field-names.description: Demonstrates merging two PDFs that contain AcroForm fields, renaming conflicting fields in the source document to keep all field names unique in the combined PDF.

fill-and-flatten-pdf-form-fields.title: Fill PDF Form Fields and Flatten to Make Them Non-Editable
fill-and-flatten-pdf-form-fields.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, populating text box, checkbox, and radio button fields, then flattening the form so the content becomes static and non‑editable before saving.

restore-editability-of-flattened-pdf-for.title: Attempt to Unflatten a PDF Form (Not Supported)
restore-editability-of-flattened-pdf-for.description: Demonstrates that Aspose.Pdf cannot restore a flattened form; the code loads a PDF, checks for a form, and saves the document unchanged.

set-form-field-appearance-custom-font.title: Apply Custom Font to PDF Form Field
set-form-field-appearance-custom-font.description: Shows how to load an external TrueType/OpenType font and set it as the appearance of a text box form field in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

rotate-form-field-label.title: Rotate Form Field Label with TextStamp
rotate-form-field-label.description: Demonstrates how to add a rotated label for a PDF form field using a TextStamp and the RotateAngle property, then save the updated document.

hide-pdf-form-field.title: Hide a PDF Form Field
hide-pdf-form-field.description: Shows how to hide a specific form field in a PDF by setting its Flags property to AnnotationFlags.Hidden using Aspose.Pdf.

set-form-field-visible-non-printable.title: Set Form Field Visible but Not Printable
set-form-field-visible-non-printable.description: Loads a PDF, retrieves a form field by name, clears the Print flag so the field remains visible on screen but is omitted from printing, and saves the document.

export-pdf-form-data-to-pretty-json.title: Export PDF Form Data to JSON with Pretty-Printing
export-pdf-form-data-to-pretty-json.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, read its form fields using Aspose.Pdf, collect field names and values, and write the data to a formatted (indented) JSON file.

import-form-data-from-compressed-json.title: Import Form Data from GZip‑Compressed JSON into PDF
import-form-data-from-compressed-json.description: Demonstrates decompressing a GZip‑compressed JSON payload and importing the form field values into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's ImportFromJson method.

create-multi-page-pdf-with-acroform-fiel.title: Create Multi‑Page PDF with Different AcroForm Fields
create-multi-page-pdf-with-acroform-fiel.description: The example creates a three‑page PDF and adds a unique set of AcroForm fields to each page, including text boxes, check boxes, radio buttons, list boxes, a signature placeholder, and a combo box.

copy-form-field-to-another-page.title: Copy Form Field to Another Page in PDF
copy-form-field-to-another-page.description: Shows how to duplicate an existing form field and place its visual appearance on a different page within the same PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

rename-pdf-form-field.title: Rename PDF Form Field Programmatically
rename-pdf-form-field.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, locate a form field by its current name, change its Name property to follow a new naming convention, and save the updated document.

clone-pdf-form-field-to-another-page.title: Clone a PDF Form Field to Another Page
clone-pdf-form-field-to-another-page.description: Demonstrates how to clone an existing TextBox form field, modify its properties, and place the cloned field on a different page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

assign-javascript-onlostfocus-to-pdf-for.title: Assign JavaScript OnLostFocus Action to PDF Form Field
assign-javascript-onlostfocus-to-pdf-for.description: Shows how to add a JavaScript action to a PDF text box field that calculates the sum of two other fields when the field loses focus, using Aspose.Pdf.

add-submit-button-to-pdf-form.title: Add Submit Button to PDF Form
add-submit-button-to-pdf-form.description: Shows how to create a push‑button in a PDF that posts all form fields to a specified URL endpoint using Aspose.Pdf.

add-reset-button-to-pdf-form.title: Add Reset Button to PDF Form
add-reset-button-to-pdf-form.description: Shows how to create a push‑button field on a PDF page, attach a JavaScript action that resets all form fields, and save the updated document.

define-calculation-order-for-pdf-form-fi.title: Set Calculation Order for PDF Form Fields
define-calculation-order-for-pdf-form-fi.description: Demonstrates how to create or retrieve form fields, define a calculation order, enable auto‑recalculation, and attach a JavaScript calculation script using Aspose.Pdf.

add-numeric-field-with-validation.title: Numeric Range Validation Utility
add-numeric-field-with-validation.description: Shows a simple method that checks whether an integer is within a specified inclusive range and throws an exception if the range definition is invalid.

list-pdf-form-field-names.title: List PDF Form Field Names
list-pdf-form-field-names.description: Shows how to open a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, verify that it contains form fields, and enumerate the names of all fields in the document.

extract-text-box-form-fields.title: Filter PDF Form Fields by Type Using LINQ
extract-text-box-form-fields.description: Demonstrates opening a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, accessing its form fields, and using a LINQ query to retrieve only TextBoxField objects.

export-pdf-form-fields-to-json__v2.title: Serialize PDF Form Fields to JSON Schema
export-pdf-form-fields-to-json__v2.description: Loads a PDF document, iterates over its form fields and generates a JSON schema that captures each field's type, required flag, maximum length and default value.

import-acroform-fields-from-json.title: Create PDF AcroForm Fields from JSON Schema
import-acroform-fields-from-json.description: Deserializes a JSON definition of form fields and dynamically adds TextBox, CheckBox, and RadioButton AcroForm fields to a newly generated PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

fill-pdf-form-and-encrypt.title: Fill PDF Form and Encrypt with AES‑256
fill-pdf-form-and-encrypt.description: The example opens a PDF form, populates various field types (text box, checkbox, radio button, combo box) and then encrypts the document using AES‑256 with user and owner passwords and specific permissions before saving.

apply-digital-signature-to-pdf.title: Add Visible Signature Field to PDF
apply-digital-signature-to-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with filled form fields, create a visible signature field on a page, add it to the form collection, and save the updated document.

set-pdf-metadata-after-form-processing.title: Set PDF Metadata After Form Processing
set-pdf-metadata-after-form-processing.description: Shows how to load a PDF, fill a form field, set document metadata such as author and title, and save the updated file using Aspose.Pdf.

fill-pdf-form-fields-from-stream.title: Fill PDF Form Fields from Byte Array
fill-pdf-form-fields-from-stream.description: Loads a PDF from a byte array, sets values for various form fields (text, checkbox, radio button, list box) and returns the modified PDF as a byte array.

async-import-xml-form-data-into-pdf.title: Asynchronously Import XML Form Data into a PDF
async-import-xml-form-data-into-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading XML form data, mapping it to matching PDF form fields, and saving the filled PDF using async/await to avoid blocking the main thread.

parallel-fill-pdf-form-fields.title: Parallel Fill PDF Form Fields in Batch
parallel-fill-pdf-form-fields.description: Shows how to process multiple PDFs concurrently, set a text form field (e.g., "Name") for each document, and save the results, leveraging Parallel.ForEach for improved batch performance.

log-form-field-modifications.title: Log PDF Form Field Modifications with Aspose.Pdf
log-form-field-modifications.description: Opens a PDF, iterates through its form fields, updates each field based on its type, records the old and new values to a log file, and saves the modified document.

generate-csv-summary-of-pdf-form-fields.title: Generate Summary Report of PDF Form Fields
generate-csv-summary-of-pdf-form-fields.description: The example scans a folder of PDFs, extracts each form field's name and value, and writes a CSV summary report. It also records files without fields or processing errors.

compare-pdf-form-data-diff-report.title: Compare PDF Form Fields and Generate Diff Report
compare-pdf-form-data-diff-report.description: The example loads two PDF documents, extracts their form fields, compares the values, and writes a text report highlighting any mismatched fields.

create-pdf-template-with-form-fields.title: Create PDF Template with Form Fields
create-pdf-template-with-form-fields.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF document that contains labeled form fields (text boxes) which can later be bound to dynamic data sources.

replace-placeholder-with-current-date.title: Replace Placeholder with Current Date in PDF Form Field
replace-placeholder-with-current-date.description: Loads a PDF, finds a text box form field, replaces its placeholder text with the current system date formatted as "MMMM dd, yyyy", and saves the updated document.

create-multi-select-listbox.title: Populate Multi-Select List Box in PDF Form
create-multi-select-listbox.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF form, enable multi‑selection on a list box field, select multiple options by their display or export values, and save the updated document.

populate-combobox-from-datatable.title: Set Combo Box Items from Database in PDF Form
populate-combobox-from-datatable.description: Demonstrates how to populate a PDF form combo box with values retrieved from a database using Aspose.Pdf, including clearing existing options and setting a default selection.

add-signature-field-to-pdf-form.title: Add Signature Field to PDF Form
add-signature-field-to-pdf-form.description: Shows how to insert a digital signature field into an existing PDF document using Aspose.Pdf and save the updated file.

extract-signature-field-image.title: Extract Signature Field Appearance as Image
extract-signature-field-image.description: Loads a PDF, locates a signature form field, extracts its visual appearance stream and saves it as a PNG for audit logging.

set-max-length-pdf-textbox-field.title: Set Maximum Length for PDF TextBox Form Field
set-max-length-pdf-textbox-field.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, locate a TextBox form field, set its MaxLen property to restrict user input, and save the updated document.

enable-spell-checking-textbox-field.title: Enable Spell Checking for PDF Text Box
enable-spell-checking-textbox-field.description: Shows how to add a text box field to a PDF and enable its spell‑checking feature using Aspose.Pdf.

export-pdf-form-data-to-xml__v2.title: Export PDF Form Data to XML
export-pdf-form-data-to-xml__v2.description: Shows how to load a PDF containing form fields with Aspose.Pdf and export the current form data to an XML file.

validate-xml-xsd-fill-xfa-pdf.title: Validate XML with XSD and Populate PDF Form
validate-xml-xsd-fill-xfa-pdf.description: The example validates an XML file against an XSD schema, extracts field values, and fills a PDF form using Aspose.Pdf.

populate-pdf-form-fields-using-xslt.title: Transform XML with XSLT and Fill PDF Form Fields
populate-pdf-form-fields-using-xslt.description: Demonstrates loading an XSLT stylesheet to transform XML data in memory and then populating an Aspose.Pdf form with the transformed values before saving the result.

create-pdf-with-acroform-calculation.title: Create PDF with AcroForm fields and JavaScript calculation
create-pdf-with-acroform-calculation.description: Demonstrates how to add AcroForm text fields to a PDF, embed JavaScript that computes a total price, and trigger the script on document open and field changes using Aspose.Pdf.

export-pdf-form-fields-to-csv.title: Export PDF Form Fields to CSV
export-pdf-form-fields-to-csv.description: Shows how to read form fields from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and write their properties (name, type, value, rectangle, etc.) to a CSV file for external analysis.

add-hidden-session-id-field-to-pdf.title: Add Hidden Session Identifier Field to PDF
add-hidden-session-id-field-to-pdf.description: Shows how to insert a hidden text box form field containing a session ID into an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

set-default-appearance-for-pdf-text-fiel.title: Set Default Appearance for PDF Text Box Field
set-default-appearance-for-pdf-text-fiel.description: Shows how to define the default font, size, and color (DA) of a text box form field in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

bulk-fill-pdf-form-fields-from-json.title: Bulk Fill PDF Form Fields with Graceful Missing-Field Handling
bulk-fill-pdf-form-fields-from-json.description: Demonstrates how to fill multiple PDF form fields using Aspose.Pdf while safely skipping fields that are missing or of an unexpected type.

add-fallback-metadata-to-pdf.title: Read XML with Default Values and Write to File
add-fallback-metadata-to-pdf.description: Shows how to load an XML document, retrieve element values with fallback defaults, and write the resolved data to a text file.

set-dashed-border-for-pdf-form-field.title: Set Dashed Border Style for PDF Form Field
set-dashed-border-for-pdf-form-field.description: Shows how to load a PDF, locate a text box form field, and apply a gray dashed border using Aspose.Pdf.

set-beveled-border-on-pdf-form-field.title: Set Form Field Border to Beveled Style
set-beveled-border-on-pdf-form-field.description: Demonstrates how to change a PDF form field's border to a beveled three‑dimensional appearance using Aspose.Pdf.

apply-background-image-to-pdf-form-field.title: Apply Background Image to PDF Form Button
apply-background-image-to-pdf-form-field.description: Loads a PDF, finds a button form field, hides its border, and adds an image stamp sized to the field rectangle to act as a background image, then saves the updated document.

export-pdf-form-data-to-indented-json.title: Export PDF Form Data to Indented JSON
export-pdf-form-data-to-indented-json.description: Demonstrates how to read form fields from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, collect them into a dictionary, and write the data as pretty‑printed JSON.

import-form-data-from-json-via-rest-api.title: Import Form Data from JSON via REST API
import-form-data-from-json-via-rest-api.description: Demonstrates how to fetch JSON data from a REST endpoint and populate an AcroForm PDF using Aspose.Pdf's ImportFromJson method, then save the filled document.

center-align-text-field-in-pdf-form.title: Center Align Text Field in PDF
center-align-text-field-in-pdf-form.description: Shows how to open a PDF, locate a TextBoxField by name, set its TextHorizontalAlignment to Center, and save the updated document.

create-right-aligned-numeric-text-field.title: Set Text Field Alignment to Right in PDF Form
create-right-aligned-numeric-text-field.description: Shows how to open a PDF, locate a TextBoxField by name, set its horizontal alignment to right for numeric entry, and save the updated document.

add-date-picker-field-to-pdf.title: Add Date Picker to PDF Form Field
add-date-picker-field-to-pdf.description: Shows how to insert a text box form field into a PDF and attach JavaScript that opens the built‑in date picker when the field receives focus.

populate-currency-value-in-pdf-form.title: Populate PDF Form Field with Formatted Currency
populate-currency-value-in-pdf-form.description: Shows how to load a PDF, format a decimal as a currency string, and assign it to a text box form field using Aspose.Pdf.

validate-email-form-field.title: Validate Email and Add Annotation to PDF
validate-email-form-field.description: The example checks that an email address contains an '@' character before modifying and saving a PDF. If the email is valid, it adds a text annotation with the email and writes the output file.

remove-form-field-from-pdf.title: Remove Specific Form Field from PDF
remove-form-field-from-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, checks for a named form field, removes it using the Form.Delete method, and saves the modified document.

insert-form-field-at-specific-index.title: Insert Form Field at Specific Index in PDF
insert-form-field-at-specific-index.description: Demonstrates how to insert a new form field at a given zero‑based position within a PDF's form field collection by reordering existing fields using Aspose.Pdf.

create-pdf-acroform-open-js.title: Create PDF with AcroForm fields and document‑level JavaScript
create-pdf-acroform-open-js.description: The example creates a PDF, adds a text box and a checkbox AcroForm field, and assigns a document‑level JavaScript action that runs when the file is opened.

export-pdf-form-data-to-json-gzip.title: Export PDF Form Data to JSON and GZip
export-pdf-form-data-to-json-gzip.description: Shows how to extract form field values from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, serialize the data to JSON, and compress the JSON with GZip for efficient storage or transmission.

import-encrypted-xfdf-form-data.title: Import Encrypted XML Form Data into PDF
import-encrypted-xfdf-form-data.description: Demonstrates how to decrypt an AES‑encrypted XML file, parse its form field values, and populate a PDF form using Aspose.Pdf.

set-rich-text-field-html.title: Set Rich Text Content in a PDF Form Field
set-rich-text-field-html.description: Shows how to assign HTML markup to a TextBoxField in a PDF form so the field displays rich‑text formatting when viewed with a supporting PDF viewer, using Aspose.Pdf.

create-pdf-with-acroform-tooltips.title: Create PDF with AcroForm fields and tooltips
create-pdf-with-acroform-tooltips.description: Demonstrates generating a PDF containing AcroForm text boxes and a checkbox, assigning tooltips via the AlternateName property, and adding descriptive labels using TextFragment.

import-form-data-from-json.title: Import Form Data from JSON into PDF
import-form-data-from-json.description: Shows how to load a PDF, import form field values from a JSON array using Form.ImportFromJson, and save the updated document.

export-pdf-form-data-to-xml-custom-root.title: Export PDF Form Data to XML with Custom Root Element
export-pdf-form-data-to-xml-custom-root.description: Demonstrates reading PDF form fields with Aspose.Pdf and manually creating an XML document that uses a custom root element to satisfy external system requirements.

add-calculated-total-field-with-javascri.title: Add Calculated Sum Field to PDF Form
add-calculated-total-field-with-javascri.description: Shows how to create numeric text box fields and a read‑only calculated field that sums them using JavaScript in an Aspose.Pdf form.

add-current-time-datefield-to-pdf.title: Set Form Field Default to Current Time on PDF Load
add-current-time-datefield-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to set a PDF form text box field's default value to the current system time (HH:mm:ss) when the document is opened, using Aspose.Pdf.

add-dynamic-barcode-field-to-pdf.title: Populate PDF Barcode Field with Dynamic Data
add-dynamic-barcode-field-to-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF template, generate a unique barcode value at runtime, assign it to a BarcodeField in the form, and save the updated document.

validate-required-pdf-form-fields-before.title: Validate Required PDF Form Fields and Export to CSV
validate-required-pdf-form-fields-before.description: Loads a PDF, checks that all required form fields contain values, and exports the filled form data to a CSV file when validation passes.

verify-pdf-form-field-count.title: Validate Form Field Count and Fill PDF Form
verify-pdf-form-field-count.description: Shows how to use Document.Form.Count to verify the expected number of form fields in a PDF, then fill text and checkbox fields before saving the document.

bind-pdf-with-formeditor-save-modified-p.title: Set TextBox Form Field Value in PDF
bind-pdf-with-formeditor-save-modified-p.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, locate a text box form field by its name, assign a new value, and save the updated document.

set-max-length-for-pdf-text-field.title: Set Text Field Character Limit in PDF Form
set-max-length-for-pdf-text-field.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, bind a FormEditor, and apply a maximum character limit to a specific text field using Aspose.Pdf.

add-checkbox-field-to-pdf-form.title: Add Checkbox Field to PDF Form
add-checkbox-field-to-pdf-form.description: Shows how to open an existing PDF, create a checkbox form field named 'AgreeTerms', add it to the document's form collection, and save the modified PDF.

remove-typewriter-form-fields-page-3.description: Loads a PDF, uses TextFragmentAbsorber on the third page, identifies all Typewriter form fields on that page, and deletes them before saving the document.

export-acroform-data-to-xml.title: Export PDF AcroForm Data to XML
export-acroform-data-to-xml.description: Loads a PDF, extracts all AcroForm field values, and writes them to an XML file named 'formdata.xml'.

import-acroform-data-from-xml.title: Import XML Form Data into PDF
import-acroform-data-from-xml.description: Demonstrates how to read AcroForm field values from an XML file and populate the corresponding fields in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf. The example handles text boxes, checkboxes, radio buttons, list boxes, and combo boxes.

add-submit-button-to-pdf.title: Configure PDF Submit Button Action and URL
add-submit-button-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to programmatically set a button field's OnActivated action to submit a PDF form to a specified URL using Aspose.Pdf.

export-acroform-data-to-xfdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, read its AcroForm fields, create an XML representation of the field data, and write the XML file to a UNC network share.

import-xml-form-data-into-multiple-pdfs.description: Shows how to read an XML file containing form field values and populate matching fields in several PDF documents, saving the updated files with Aspose.Pdf.

remove-form-fields-first-page.title: Remove First Page Form Fields from PDF
remove-form-fields-first-page.description: Shows how to delete all form fields that reside on the first page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, producing a clean template page.

add-paymentmethod-radio-button-group.title: Add PaymentMethod Radio Button Group to PDF

set-default-selected-radio-button-value.description: Demonstrates how to programmatically set the default selected option of a radio button group in a PDF form using Aspose.Pdf.

add-multiline-feedback-text-field.title: Create Multiline Feedback Text Field in PDF

remove-signature-form-fields.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through a PDF's form collection, identify signature fields, and delete them using Aspose.Pdf.

export-pdf-form-fields-to-csv__v2.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, read each form field's name and current value, and write the data to a CSV file for external processing.

create-hidden-audit-timestamp-field.description: Shows how to create a PDF with a hidden text box form field that stores the document creation timestamp for audit purposes.

set-pdf-form-field-read-only__v2.description: Loads a PDF, finds a specified form field, marks it as read‑only to prevent user modifications, and saves the updated document.

add-calculation-button-to-pdf-form.description: Shows how to load a PDF, locate a button form field, attach a JavaScript action that multiplies Quantity and UnitPrice fields to compute a Total, and save the updated document.

remove-javascript-actions-from-pdf-form-.description: Shows how to load a PDF, iterate over all form fields, and clear any attached JavaScript actions to enhance document security before distribution.

batch-convert-pdfs-to-xml.title: Batch Convert PDFs to XML Form Data
batch-convert-pdfs-to-xml.description: Shows how to process all PDF files in a directory and save each as XML form data using Aspose.Pdf.

export-selected-form-fields-to-xml.title: Export Selected PDF Form Fields to XML
export-selected-form-fields-to-xml.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, retrieving specific form fields by name, and writing their values into an XML file.

create-pdf-date-field-validation.description: Shows how to verify that a string matches the MM/DD/YYYY pattern by using a compiled Regex in C#.

add-reset-button-to-pdf-form__v2.description: Shows how to create a button field on a PDF page that clears all form fields using JavaScript when clicked.

add-tooltip-to-pdf-submit-button.title: Add Tooltip to PDF Submit Button
add-tooltip-to-pdf-submit-button.description: Demonstrates how to set a tooltip (alternate name) on a submit button field in a PDF form using Aspose.Pdf, then save the updated document.

set-text-field-background-color-light-gr.title: Set Text Field Background Color in PDF
set-text-field-background-color-light-gr.description: Shows how to load a PDF, locate a text box form field, and change its background color to light gray using Aspose.Pdf.

export-pdf-form-data-to-xml__v4.title: Export Calculated Tax from PDF Form to XML
export-pdf-form-data-to-xml__v4.description: Loads a PDF form, reads the 'Amount' field, computes a 10% tax, and writes the original amount and tax value to an XML file.

pdf-form-language-switch.title: Create PDF Form with Language‑Dependent Labels
pdf-form-language-switch.description: Shows how to add a language selection combo box to a PDF form and dynamically change read‑only label fields using JavaScript actions.

batch-apply-custom-font-to-pdf-form-text.title: Batch Apply Custom Font to PDF Form Text Fields
batch-apply-custom-font-to-pdf-form-text.description: Demonstrates how to load a TrueType font once and apply it to all text box fields in multiple PDF documents stored in a network folder.

batch-fill-pdf-form-from-datatable.title: Batch Generate PDF Forms from a Template
batch-fill-pdf-form-from-datatable.description: Loads a PDF form template, fills text fields with data from a collection of records, optionally flattens the form, and saves a separate PDF for each record.

post-pdf-form-data-xml.title: Post PDF Form Data as XML to a Remote Endpoint
post-pdf-form-data-xml.description: Loads a PDF, extracts its form fields, builds a simple XML representation of the field names and values, and posts the XML to a specified web service using HttpClient.

create-pdf-acroform-textbox-absolute-coo.title: Create PDF with AcroForm Fields Using Absolute Coordinates
create-pdf-acroform-textbox-absolute-coo.description: The example demonstrates how to generate a PDF document and place AcroForm fields (text box, checkbox, radio button group) at exact positions using absolute coordinates, customizing their appearance.

create-pdf-form-with-barcode-field.title: Create PDF Form with Barcode Field
create-pdf-form-with-barcode-field.description: Shows how to generate a PDF document, add a TextBoxField, render a barcode into that field, and save the form using Aspose.Pdf.

create-pdf-with-acroform-fields-and-marg.title: Create PDF with AcroForm Fields and Page Margins
create-pdf-with-acroform-fields-and-marg.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF document, set uniform page margins, and add AcroForm fields (a text box and a checkbox) using Aspose.Pdf.

set-custom-font-for-signature-field.title: Set Custom Font for Signature Field
set-custom-font-for-signature-field.description: Demonstrates how to load a TrueType font and assign it to a PDF signature form field using the DefaultAppearance property.

apply-custom-font-to-pdf-form-fields.title: Apply Custom Font to PDF Form Text Fields
apply-custom-font-to-pdf-form-fields.description: Demonstrates loading a TrueType font and setting it as the default appearance for all text box fields in a PDF form using Aspose.Pdf.

export-form-field-appearances.title: Export Form Field Appearance Streams to PDF Files
export-form-field-appearances.description: Loads a PDF, iterates its form fields, extracts each field's normal appearance XObject, and saves the appearance as a separate PDF for visual inspection.

replace-xfa-with-acroform-xml-template.title: Replace XFA Form with AcroForm Using XML Template
replace-xfa-with-acroform-xml-template.description: Shows how to remove an XFA form from a PDF and create an AcroForm by importing field definitions from an XML template with Aspose.Pdf.

export-pdf-form-appearance-to-json.title: Export PDF Form Field Appearance Settings to JSON
export-pdf-form-appearance-to-json.description: Shows how to read appearance properties (font, size, colors, etc.) of form fields in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and write them to a JSON file for reuse in other templates.

add-progress-bar-field-to-pdf-form.title: Add a Progress Bar to a PDF Form with JavaScript
add-progress-bar-field-to-pdf-form.description: Demonstrates how to insert a TextBox field that acts as a progress bar in an existing PDF form and update it dynamically using JavaScript actions tied to checkbox fields.

create-localized-pdf-form.title: Create Localized PDF Form with Dynamic Label
create-localized-pdf-form.description: Demonstrates how to build a PDF form with a locale selector that updates a label field's text using JavaScript based on the selected language.

add-dynamic-code128-barcode-to-pdf.title: Synchronize Code128 Barcode with Text Field in PDF
add-dynamic-code128-barcode-to-pdf.description: Shows how to set a BarcodeField to Code128 and automatically update its value whenever a linked TextBoxField changes, using JavaScript actions in Aspose.Pdf.
